segments.speaker: Daffy Duck
segments.text: Now, I'll hide up here. If you want to find me, keep the inside view button pressed down.

segments.speaker: Daffy Duck
segments.text: If you want to follow me, and who wouldn't, use the jump button and just do what I'm doing.

segments.speaker: Daffy Duck
segments.text: If you want to jump higher, press the button a second time when you're at the highest point of your jump. Works like a charm.

segments.speaker: Daffy Duck
segments.text: Might I also suggest you use the jump button to take a flying leap?

segments.speaker: Daffy Duck
segments.text: Oh, oh I do crack myself up. Seriously though, if you want to be good at this game, you'll have to use the old noggin. Come on, follow me up to the road.

segments.speaker: Daffy Duck
segments.text: If you want to hang an object onto the end of the fishing line, use the combine feature in your inventory, why don't you?

segments.speaker: Daffy Duck
segments.text: If you want to unhook an object from the end of the fishing line, use the dissociate feature in your inventory.

segments.speaker: Daffy Duck
segments.text: Get this! You can hang several different objects onto the end of the fishing line. If you don't believe me, look in the user guide at the object list.
